bullets.text: CityFibre's Growth Ambitions - **CityFibre**'s new CEO emphasizes altnet consolidation to expand service reach.
UK MNOs Eye mmWave Spectrum - **Ofcom** approves auction for mmWave spectrum, enhancing mobile network capabilities.
Transforming Customer Experience - Telecoms shift focus from metrics to personalized engagement for improved satisfaction.
Medusa Cable Expansion Begins - The **Medusa** submarine cable system starts connecting Southern Europe and North Africa.
Orange Business Enhances Crisis Comms - **Orange Business** integrates **OneWeb** for rapid emergency connectivity solutions.
Verizon's New Leadership - **Daniel Schulman**, ex-PayPal CEO, appointed as **Verizon**'s new CEO to drive growth.
5G-A Innovations Unveiled - **Huawei** highlights 5G-A and AI's role in reshaping telecom operator value.
Private 5G Networks Expand - **Airbus** partners with **Ericsson** to deploy private 5G for smart factory operations.
